lifestage.quote: a complete and balanced pet food for adult cats

special-diet.quote: Formulated for the well-being of your sterilised cat

health-feature.quote: low fat content** to maintain ideal body weight

texts.about_this_item: Monge Natural Superpremium Monoprotein Sterilised Cat Beef is a complete and balanced pet food for adult sterilised cats, formulated with a unique animal protein source (beef) and low fat content plus L-carnitine to support ideal body weight and lean mass. Enriched with XOS prebiotics, rose hip and yucca schidigera. No added dyes or artificial preservatives.
texts.ingredient_information: Beef (dried 26% and fresh meat 10%), wheat, maize gluten, maize, potato protein, animal fat (chicken oil purified at 99.5%), hydrolysed animal proteins (liver), fish oil (salmon oil), pea fibre, minerals, yeasts products (mannan-oligosaccharides MOS 1%), xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.3%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), products from the processing of herbs (rose hip 0.1%).
texts.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes may be split into 2 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and living conditions of the animal. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times.
